project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 23 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Worfield qualifies as a local detour through Medieval cross in St Peter's churchyard and CHURCH OF ST PETER. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Worfield: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Worfield offers Medieval cross in St Peter's churchyard, CHURCH OF ST PETER, WORFIELD CHURCH OF ENGLAND PRIMARY SCHOOL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Medieval cross in St Peter's churchyard
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Medieval cross in St Peter's churchyard and CHURCH OF ST PETER, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
